purpose: Test the distinct chart-derived claim that common industry demand creates many simultaneous V22 candidates but only the cleanest stock-level supply/demand structure should be purchased. This uses causal global-state routing and one deterministic representative per PIT industry/date rather than another threshold rescue.
relationship_to_v23: V23 is closed at its frozen failed gate. V24 does not change any V23 threshold and does not select a Top-N. It tests an independent cross-sectional redundancy/composition mechanism observed across the complete V22 chart corpus.

chart_basis.observation: same-industry and same-date candidate clusters contain both winners and losers; visually stronger cases have less overhead/maturity on the bull side and clearer selling-pressure decay plus demand recovery on the bear side

global_route.timing: global state is known at signal-date close and uses no future observation

frozen_rules.local_alignment: the candidate already belongs to the matching V22 PIT-industry LOCAL_BULL or LOCAL_BEAR state
frozen_rules.one_per_industry_date: within signal_date, PIT causal_industry, and routed mechanism retain exactly the first deterministic structural ranking; this is economic common-mode deduplication, not a fitted Top-N
bull_priority: valid exact 126-session history before invalid history
fewer prior-126 daily ranges intersecting [signal close, 1.15 * signal close]
smaller exact prior-20 return to avoid the more mature path
bear_priority: smaller last5_downside_turnover / previous5_downside_turnover, with zero previous turnover ranked last
frozen_rules.execution: reuse exact V22 target, horizon, entry, T+1, limit, suspension, corporate-action, and 40 bp round-trip-cost outcomes

development_governance.validation_open_condition: every year 2014-2020 has >50 completed events and mean net event return >4.0%

predeclared_outputs: annual count and mean/median net return
